title: Craft Conformance Feature Registry Schema
description: Schema for craft/conformance/features.yaml, mapping Craft feature blueprint requirements to conformance test suites and claiming harnesses. It is A2UI's features.schema.json with Craft's feature IDs and harnesses.

FeatureId.description: Feature identifier F-CRAFT-<AREA>-<n>: requirement n of the Craft feature blueprint that AREA names.

HarnessId.description: Identifier of a conformance harness claiming support for a feature: dart-craft runs the YAML suites in packages/a2ui_craft; dart-craft-flutter stands for the widget tests of the Flutter packages.

title.description: Human-readable summary of the feature requirement.

specAnchor.description: Repository-relative path and optional #heading-slug or #Lnn anchor to the specification or catalog source of truth.

blueprintAnchor.description: Repository-relative path and optional #heading-slug or #Lnn anchor to the module or feature blueprint.

claimedBy.description: Harnesses claiming compliance with this feature.

uncovered.description: Explanation when a feature has no tagged conformance YAML case yet (for example, covered only by unit or E2E tests, or tracked as an implementation gap).

knownGaps.description: Per-harness known gaps with the reason why a claiming harness does not yet execute a tagged case for this feature.
